title: Region editing on GPT Image, real layers on Seedream 5.0 Pro
notes:
- Region editing now works on GPT Image 2.5: draw boxes on a GPT Image result and edit them in place. Each box is cropped, edited by Sunburst on its own and stitched back, so everything outside the boxes stays pixel-exact (OpenAI's own mask is only guidance)
- Layers on Seedream 5.0 Pro use the model's native layer decomposition: one call splits the picture into a base plus up to 16 transparent PNG layers with names, descriptions and boxes, saved full-canvas for Photoshop or Figma (each layer is billed as one image)
- Region edits open in their own Edits tab with a history strip: the last 15 edits as thumbnails, up to 3 pinned, up to 4 edits running side by side with the main generator (the xN control fires several at once), and the region button glows purple while you draw
- Region panel: pick how many takes to fire (x1-x4); the original image sits in the edit history; hold Shift while drawing and the bars step aside so you can see behind them
- Tune / Library switch on the right drawer: your renders from the output folder, newest first - drag one onto the image, the inputs rail or the refs
- Region mode dims everything that does not apply, Esc leaves it and the region button always lets you out; boxes can share a slot number so both wheels go into one edit; Ctrl+V a screenshot into the prompt to add it as a reference; the region seed field is gone (the engines ignore it)
- Boxes that share a slot are edited as ONE crop: the model sees both wheels at once and only the boxes are pasted back; Gemini stays usable in region mode; Ctrl+V a screenshot into a region's text attaches it as the reference (with a thumbnail); the Edits tab opens as soon as an edit fires; the history sits inside the bottom bar; Shift while typing no longer hides the panel
- Fix: region boxes are measured against the picture itself, not the viewer - on portrait renders the edit used to land in the wrong place; the region button stays lit and clickable so region mode can always be left
- Region mode stays on after an edit fires (boxes too) until you leave it; edits apply to the image on screen; Last prompt button in the region card
- History: double-click removes a thumb, hold one to see it big; a running edit is cancelled only with its x (a plain click used to kill it)
- Boxes that share a slot are edited together only when they sit close - two wheels are two crops again, each with enough context around it
- The library never greys out while generating; hold a tile to see it big
- A running edit shows itself on the picture: purple glass with a sheen over the boxes it works on
- Shift + right-drag draws a freehand region (lightly smoothed) - the edit follows the drawn shape
- When an edit lands its boxes disappear under a short glass flash; the busy glass follows a freehand shape exactly
- Alt + wheel zooms the picture at the cursor, Space + drag pans, Alt + double-click resets the view
